title: TC-LOGIN-001: Administrator logs into the system
description: Verify that an Administrator can log in with valid credentials and is redirected to the admin portal with full admin access including Dashboard, User Management, Product List, Promotions, Notifications, Reports, Analytics, and Predictions.
preconditions: The administrator account exists in the user table and has an active status.
postconditions: Administrator is authenticated and redirected to the administrator portal with full admin access.
steps_actions:
1. The Administrator opens the login page.
2. The Administrator enters a valid username and password.
3. The system validates the credentials against the user and role records.
4. The system redirects the Administrator to the administrator portal.
steps_results:
1. The login page is displayed with username and password fields.
2. Credentials are accepted in the respective input fields.
3. The system authenticates the account successfully and identifies the admin role.
4. The Administrator portal (Dashboard) is displayed with admin functions: User Management, Product List, Product Settings, Inventory, Sales, Customers, Replacement, Analytics, Promotions, Reports, Users.

2. Credentials are accepted in the respective input fields.
3. The system authenticates the account and identifies the cashier/sales_staff role.
4. The sales portal is displayed with access to Point of Sale, Sales History, Replacement, and Customers.

description: Verify that Inventory Staff can record a stock-out adjustment for an existing inventory record.

title: TC-SALE-003: Adding product with insufficient stock
description: Verify that the system prevents adding products to the cart when inventory stock is insufficient.

postconditions: The product is not added to the cart and a stock availability error is displayed.

title: TC-SALE-004: System computes subtotal, discount, and total amount
description: Verify that the system correctly computes transaction totals including automatic promotion discounts (percentage, fixed, BOGO, bundle).
preconditions: The Cashier is logged in. At least one product is added to the transaction cart. Active promotions may exist for products in the cart.
postconditions: The system correctly computes and displays subtotal, discount amount (from promotions), and total amount.
steps_actions:
1. The Cashier reviews the cart with added products.
2. The system checks for active promotions linked to products in the cart via promo_product.
3. The system applies valid discounts (percentage discount, fixed amount, BOGO, or bundle) when applicable.
4. The system computes subtotal, discount amount, and total amount and displays the final amount.
steps_results:
1. The cart displays products with quantities, unit prices (SRP), and line totals.
2. Active promotions within valid date/time window are identified for eligible products.
3. Discounts are calculated: percentage of price, fixed amount off, BOGO logic, or bundle discount. Margin safety check prevents negative margins.
4. The POS screen shows subtotal (sum of line_totals), discount_amount (sum of applied discounts), and total_amount (subtotal - discount). Store credit can also be applied.

title: TC-PAY-002: System rejects insufficient payment amount
description: Verify that the system rejects payment when the amount paid is less than the total amount.

postconditions: Payment is rejected and an error message is displayed.
steps_actions:
1. The Cashier selects a payment method.

3. The system validates the payment amount against the total amount.

2. The amount is entered.

title: TC-PAY-003: System generates change, finalizes transaction, deducts stock, and generates receipt
description: Verify that completing a payment finalizes the transaction: computes change, deducts inventory, creates inventory_log entries, and generates a printable receipt.
preconditions: Payment amount is valid (amount_paid >= total_amount).
postconditions: Transaction is finalized. Stock is deducted. Inventory_log entries are created (type: 'sale'). Receipt is generated. Sales analytics and summary are updated.
steps_actions:
1. The system computes the change amount (amount_paid - total_amount).
2. The system sets the payment_status to 'paid' and sales_status to 'Completed'.
3. The system saves sales_transaction, sales_details, and payment records.
4. The system deducts stock from inventory for each sold product and creates inventory_log entries.
5. The system updates sales_analytics and sales_summary.
6. The system generates receipt details and displays the receipt dialog.
steps_results:
1. Change amount is calculated correctly.
2. Payment and sales statuses are updated.
3. All transaction records are persisted in the database.
4. Stock quantities are reduced by sold quantities. Inventory_log entries with transaction_type='sale' are created for each product.
5. Sales analytics and daily sales summary are synchronized.
6. Receipt is available for viewing and printing with full transaction details: products, quantities, prices, discounts, subtotal, total, payment info, change, cashier, date/time.

title: TC-PAY-004: Payment with GCash method

2. The Cashier enters the amount paid.

4. The system records payment and finalizes the transaction.

2. Amount is entered.
3. Payment is validated successfully.
4. Payment record is created with payment_method='gcash', payment_status='paid'. Transaction is completed.

2. Store credit amount is applied to reduce the invoice total.
3. The total is reduced by the applied store credit. customer_credits.available_credit is updated.
4. Payment is completed for the remaining amount. A customer_credit_transaction with txn_type='use' is recorded.
